name: bricked-property-comps
description: Run property comps with your Bricked account.

interface.longDescription: Run property comps with Bricked from ChatGPT. Connect your Bricked account and select your organization. Create a property analysis, list saved analyses, or open a saved analysis to see its comparable sales, property values, and repairs. Each new analysis uses one comp from your allowance. Requires a Bricked account with access to property analysis.
defaultPrompt: Run comps for 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue NW, Washington, DC.
List my saved Bricked property analyses.
Show the comps for my most recent saved Bricked analysis.

publication.release_notes: Updated the sample property address and added the demo recording.

positive.prompt: Run Bricked property comps for 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue NW, Washington, DC.
positive.expected_behavior: Create and save an analysis for the requested address. Return the comparable sales, available property values, and links to the saved analysis. Use one comp from the connected organization's allowance.

positive.description: Create an analysis with search filters
positive.prompt: Run Bricked comps for 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue NW, Washington, DC. Use sales from the last 12 months within 2 miles.
positive.expected_behavior: Call create_property_analysis with timeframe set to 12 and searchRadiusMiles set to 2. Return the saved analysis or a clear message if no comparable sales are found.

positive.description: Create an analysis with repair estimates
positive.prompt: Run Bricked comps for 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue NW, Washington, DC, and estimate repairs for new kitchen cabinets and a new asphalt shingle roof.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the repair request in the repairs input. Return the property analysis and itemized repair estimates when available. Do not invent repair results that the tool did not return.

positive.prompt: List my saved Bricked property analyses.
positive.expected_behavior: List the saved API property analyses in the connected organization. Show the property addresses and returned pagination information. Do not create a new analysis or use a comp from the allowance.

positive.description: Read the most recent saved analysis
positive.prompt: Show the comparable sales, property values, and repairs for my most recent saved Bricked property analysis.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the most recent saved API analysis with list_properties, then call get_property with its id. Show the returned comparable sales, available property values, repairs, and analysis links. Do not create a new analysis or use a comp from the allowance.

negative.description: Explain comparable sales without an analysis
negative.prompt: Explain what comparable sales mean in real estate. Do not run comps or access my Bricked account.
negative.expected_behavior: Answer the general question without calling any Bricked tools.

negative.description: Draft a message without running comps
negative.prompt: Write an email to my real estate agent asking them to prepare comparable sales. Do not run a property analysis.
negative.expected_behavior: Draft the requested email without calling any Bricked tools or creating an analysis.

negative.prompt: Explain how to repair a loose brick in a garden wall.
negative.expected_behavior: Answer the repair question without calling Bricked property-analysis tools.
